category.start.name: The Awakening
category.start.desc: You wake on a drifting fragment of Aethelgard, cut from the world by the World Devourer. Learn to survive, gather pebbles and build your Fountain.
category.generator.name: The First Real Generator
category.generator.desc: The Devourer's stasis fields still hold your fragment. The Spring Stone and a ring of stone bricks turn your Fountain into a generator. A wrong ring never costs you anything.
category.variety.name: Different Generators
category.variety.desc: Dunes for sand and gravel, frost for ice and Frostium. Other survivors answer the Call: the market opens.
category.tiers.name: Raise the Generators
category.tiers.desc: The Forge, the cores, tiers I to IV. The crystallised memories of Aethelgard answer your hammer, and progress speeds up.
category.rift.name: The Hub and the Rift
category.rift.desc: With the Bronze armor on your back the Call shows you the way out of the islet: the Hub, its people, and the Rift where the first Echo waits.
category.nether.name: The Nether and the Ember
category.nether.desc: Your fragment has a slag-red twin. Through a portal wait the Ember generator, quartz and soul sand.
category.end.name: The End and the Void
category.end.desc: The Void Lens opens /island end. The Echo of the Rift haunts the Void.
category.farm.name: Farming and Food
category.farm.desc: Quiet work for a fragment that is learning to grow things again. Play it alongside the generators.
category.forging.name: Forge and Gear
category.forging.desc: Everything the Forge makes, from the bronze tools to the Bastion keys.
category.machines.name: Machines and Energy
category.machines.desc: Coal, cables on redstone, batteries, solar panels, then Miners that break the generator for you.
category.market.name: Market and Economy
category.market.desc: Sell, buy and auction. The market never sells or buys the rarest things.
category.dungeons.name: Dungeons
category.dungeons.desc: Rooms and secrets below the Hub. Floors 6 and 7 hold the Wing Cores.
category.bosses.name: The Bosses
category.bosses.desc: The Guardians keep the Devourer's laws in order, and the Echo of the Rift is its torn-off hunger. Each has its own silhouette and its glowing weak spot.
category.mastery.name: Mastery
category.mastery.desc: Long goals for survivors who have done it all.
category.challenges.name: Challenges
category.challenges.desc: Long days of plain work: bigger numbers, once each.
category.grove.name: The Whispering Grove
category.grove.desc: Realm 2. Roots as wide as towers, spores that glow, islands that live. The Mycelial Queen keeps the living codes of the old world.
category.heights.name: The Frozen Heights
category.heights.desc: Realm 3. Cities stopped in the ice, a cold that is the absence of motion, a sky that is almost within reach. The Boreal Watcher holds the world still.
category.marsh.name: The Putrid Marshes
category.marsh.desc: Realm 5. Everything the Devourer threw away ends up here, and the Marsh keeps it. The Mire Abomination digests what the world discards.
category.citadel.name: The Citadel of Golden Sands
category.citadel.desc: Realm 4. Rivers of gold dust that flow upward, an hourglass the size of a tower. The Temporal Pharaoh counts the hours the Devourer stole.
